title: Save six ADDs in the actual P104 opening preparation (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped exact construction with finite corroboration, produced by Nick Petalas. Factor PR6621's actual opening preparation through existing inactive owned slot 770 and restore the slot to zero.

```diff
- 18 ADDs: repeat r471 + r525/2 + 2*r704 for six destinations
+ 12 ADDs: compute once, deliver six times, uncompute
+ one INIT and one zero CLEAR
```

The prefix saves six ADD instructions and four events. The emitted word has 18,557 events instead of 18,561. The same 29 owned labels suffice; the active-owned peak does not increase. Every frame transition, productive target, public boundary and suffix event is retained literally. The recursive signed-invoice delta is zero, so no new κ is claimed.

For input components bounded by A, the temporary is at most 7A/2 and public prefix states remain at most 9A/2, the old bound. Exact dyadic execution needs no additional fractional bit. The local ordinary-work saving at ADD/INIT/CLEAR prices a,i,c is 6a-i-c. A physical runtime gain still requires pricing that lifetime.

Source: DreamingOfClouds's PR6621, exact head `c51a142bb94c6d46ebee9a48c3f71cde8022da91`. Its expression and recipients are credited; the construction retains Ali Romman's native word and the Rohan Arun, Erwan L. and earlier lineage. The two retained source members and their original NOTICE are unchanged. Common-subexpression factoring and compute/uncompute are classical; the new contribution is this exact source-bound substitution and resource ledger.

The [proof and executable package](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/1025aa5f742a760da526df56e354f618b95f2bf5/research/p104-shared-preparation) are self-contained. No unmerged predecessor Git object or verifier import is required. No predecessor native/caller/root/moment audit was run or claimed.

## Evidence

Local CPython 3.12.15 normal and optimized checks pass: nine basis columns, all 512 signed unit-box vertices, 17 signed dyadic inputs and seven rejection controls. Each registered command took about 0.12 seconds locally. The official ten-file export passes integrity checking and direct normal/optimized replay from read-only files with an empty PATH and no Git checkout. The emitter produced the revised word and rejected existing and in-checkout destinations. Committed bytes and source-history preflight pass for the ten package files.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-shared-preparation
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-shared-preparation --check-source-history
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/p104-shared-preparation/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/p104-shared-preparation/verify.py
```

Replace the interpreter path with a local CPython 3.12 path elsewhere. To emit the word, run the same interpreter with `-B research/p104-shared-preparation/rewrite.py /absolute/external/WORD.json.gz`, using a new external destination. The verifier prints `PASS_P104_SHARED_PREPARATION` and a generated receipt bound to all package files.

## Limitations

This is a local exact instruction-count improvement. Full supplier correctness, physical allocation/movement/cleanup costs, rounded error correlations, compiler/caller admission and the five inherited framework assumptions remain unproved here. No complete native or outer replay, proof-kernel check, global optimality result or selected-frontier change is claimed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

The [advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19380492) aimed at paid-transition fusion. The [scope update](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19380656) narrows delivery to this first smaller ordinary-work result. The construction search stopped at this improvement.

## Related open work

- PR6621 supplies the exact native word and opening preparation; this PR changes only that prefix and claims none of its numerical invoice as new.
- PR6638 audits PR6621's predecessor comparison gate; this local substitution leaves that separate review obligation unresolved.
- PR6674 excludes seven main-signal bypasses in PR6621; this construction retains every paid hop and public reader map.
- PR6529 supplies the earlier scaled-transport native word; its recursive profiles and correction are inherited, not reverified here.
- PR6545 changes the caller through Gaussian retirement; this scalar prefix does not alter that caller identity.
- PR6551 rebalances the retirement tree; this prefix does not alter its tree or productive-target allocation.

## Open next questions

- Price the new zero-restored lifetime on an actual physical caller and test 6a > i+c, including allocation and cleanup.
- Bind the nine-input substitution to a rounded backend and derive the changed error correlations before reusing any approximate caller tolerance.

Two-way door; isolated research package. No shared implementation or selected-frontier file changes.
